title: Minimax Policy Regret from Noisy Observational Records under Proxy and Accurate-Score Deployment
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=subfield < floor=field; paper_score_ceiling 7 < 7.4; not salvageable within scope. Math referee PASS; independent validity gate confirms downgraded.
gap_reasons: The significance is confined to one known channel, uniform one-dimensional circular design, and fixed smoothness exponent, leaving the dependence on measurement quality and nuisance smoothness unresolved.
The n^8 quadrature establishes computational finiteness without a usable implementation or delivered finite-sample evidence, limiting the practical significance credited in the projected score.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 discharged the full-class no-log proxy-deployment and accurate-deployment regret rates n^(-2/47) and n^(-1/52), the uniform forward certificate, total finite-computation policies, and matching all-policy converses; the math referee passed with no findings. Independent novelty review graded subfield below the field floor with projected paper ceiling 7 below 7.4, no in-scope salvage, and two unrepaired structural ballast findings; the main-owned validity gate confirmed downgraded. Formalization did not begin: no Lean proof or type-check claim is made; any future re-raise needs a material re-anchor rather than deletion of redundant nodes.
tldr: On the entire fixed class \(\mathcal M\), the same noisy observational training records yield sharp minimax own-oracle regret rates \(R_n^W\asymp n^{-2/47}\) for proxy deployment and \(R_n^X\asymp n^{-1/52}\) for accurate-score deployment, with no logarithmic factors. Explicit jointly Borel policies are total and computationally finite for every sample size; both upper bounds are uniform and both lower bounds cover all randomized Borel policies on that same class. The proved second-order forward-score certificate requires only clipping of the independent pilot. The ratio satisfies \(R_n^W/R_n^X\asymp n^{-57/2444}\to0\). This separates learning difficulties relative to different oracles. Sample by sample, the loss of a proxy-deployed rule relative to the latent oracle is \(\bigl[\int\tau_+\,d\mu-\int g_+\,d\mu\bigr]+D_W(P,\pi_n)\): deployment-information loss plus proxy-own-oracle learning regret. The faster proxy learning rate does not establish greater attainable welfare.
gap: Existing inverse-classification and quadratic-convolution results address different targets. Published proxy-policy guarantees use different policy restrictions, assignment information, and oracle loss.
fill: Uniform original-record upper guarantees and positive causal likelihood lower constructions determine whether the proxy oracle is statistically easier to approach, without changing the law class or charging proxy information loss as learning regret.
